messages:
Lara: Heads-up: vendor roadmap call today flagged constrained B200 shipments and a potential H200 rebaseline to late July. Need quick decisions on marketplace sequencing.
Mateo: Oof. Which GA bucket is B200 in for us?
Lara: Initially Wave C (target 2026-07-10) but many SI integrations expected to test against B200 for perf-sensitive workloads.
Sunil: From infra: B200 power profile causes cooling spikes in our small racks. We recommended larger pool for Dedicated. That affects beta footprint.
Raj: Sales note: a couple of enterprise pilots signed specifically for B200 perf. If we delay, risk churn. Can we offer alternate hardware or do a hybrid routing?
Elena: Hybrid routing sounds viable: route latency-sensitive inference to H100x, throughput batch jobs to B200 once available. Docs must be explicit.
Mateo: Also vendor mentioned NRE for Gaudi ABI change next month. If they push ABI, our Gaudi cert will need retest.
Lara: Proposed plan: 1) Freeze Wave A: H100 + H100x (GA 2026-06-15). 2) Wave B: Gaudi + MI300 (soft gate pending ABI + ROCm patch) 2026-06-29. 3) Wave C: B200 & H200 (dependent on vendor shipping) 2026-07-15. Communicate rolling availability.
Sunil: Tech ask: can we provide a limited "SI preview" for B200 using emulated performance on H100x? We can surface perf deltas in the marketplace SKU page.
Raj: SIs will accept preview if we label it as "performance preview" and provide benchmarking kit. They need a stable SDK.
Mateo: I'll draft the benchmark kit: docker image + perf script + sample workloads.
Elena: Legal: any SI preview requires NDA + embargo agreement. Partner-bot, flag partner that preview access list must be approved.
partner-bot: Note: partner preview access requires partner written consent and PR approval.
Lara: Ops: we need to create SKU flags: "rolling-availability", "preview", "beta-driver". Marketplace owners, can you add these tags?
Sunil: Can do. Also adding auto-routing rules: if B200 backends unavailable, fallback to H100x with quantization.
Mateo: Quick snippet for perf harness we'll give SIs:
```
# run perf harness
docker run --rm -v $(pwd)/workloads:/work workloads/bench:latest \
  --model t5-large --batch 8 --tokens 1024 --runs 50
```
Include instructions to upload traces back to our S3 test bucket.
Raj: Communications: propose message to customers: "We are launching H100 and H100x on June 15. Gaudi and MI300 rolling in late June pending partner fixes. B200 & H200 will follow in July as inventory permits." Keep it conservative.
Elena: Marketing wants a partner co-branded asset. We can do a partner blog for Wave A and a joint "rolling availability" microsite for the rest.
Lara: Embargo rules: partner needs 72h notice for any public announcement and SI playbooks only after certification. No early public mention of B200 shipping dates.
partner-bot: Reminder: embargo must be recorded in PRR doc.
Mateo: Ops also requests a small canary of 6 B200-equivalent VMs (or H100x configured to mimic B200) for SI testing.
Sunil: I'll provision a canary pool and automate health checks. Add a job to block promotion if GPU temp spikes > threshold.
Raj: Will SIs accept a short-term SLA deviation for preview? We should let them know it's preview, not production SLA.
Elena: Yes, label as "preview access - limited SLA". Also collect feedback via a short form.
Lara: Action items: Mateo prepare benchmark kit and preview instructions; Sunil create canary pool and health gates; Raj compile SI list and outreach; Elena own customer comms draft; I'll confirm with vendor on firm ship dates and ABI timeline.
release-bot: /schedule-release waveA --date=2026-06-15 --notify=@marketing @sales
Mateo: Drafting benchmark kit now, will share link in thread.
Sunil: Canary pool created (staging), health checks wired to CI.
Lara: Vendor updated: tentative B200 bulk ship now mid-July, H200 moved to 2026-07-20. They've promised weekly updates.
Raj: Ok moving customer pilots to temporary H100x routing and informing SIs.
Elena: Posted draft customer note to https://redwood-internal/comms/waveA-draft (internal). Feedback welcome.
Lara: Great work. We'll reconvene next Wed after vendor update. Closing thread for now. :rocket:
